decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering through several accessory items like patches, blankets, and tools, I focused on the actual backpacks available in the feed. The consideration set includes a range of options from ultralight (Granite Gear) to tactical (Seibertron and G4Free) and hydration-specific (Gelindo) or waterproof (Piscifun) bags. I ultimately chose the Seibertron Falcon (prod_backpacks_107) as it offers a robust 37L capacity and has excellent reviews regarding its versatility and durability for its $59.99 price point. Other options like the Granite Gear had worrying reviews about strap failure, and the G4Free had reports of breaking under school-use loads, making the Seibertron the most reliable choice in the set.
